notes.title: Update May 29
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added profile select to game launch.
Player can now choose between 3 profiles when starting the game.
Existing profiles will be in slot Profile 1
[*]Fixed bug with large stacks of objects falling into water causing a crash.
[*]Fixed overworld bug near entrance to Courier New in The Forest.
[*]Changed gamepad menu confirmation button to gamepad A.
[*] Fixed glitch with lighting when first launching play mode.
[/list]

Next up is Steamworks Integration and some additional puzzles.
